behaviour: The paired ledger load gate compares the busiest CPU window of the process that takes writes on both sides, so a head running the ledger API service beside the read only ledger server pairs against a base running one combined server; the read only server's own window is reported apart on the head only and never paired, while the absolute CPU budget still holds every server process.
seam: The load gate run measure line, fed by the process sampler and read by the paired grader
